plan_text:
Easy Bike & Birding in Chapultepec

1. Bosque de Chapultepec (1a sección) (10 min) — Start with a gentle introduction to the park's natural beauty.
2. Parque México — área de aves (15 min) — Excellent spot for birdwatching with a variety of species.
3. Ciclovía Reforma (10 min) — Enjoy a relaxed bike ride along this popular route.

Rain: Jardin del Arte / Sullivan – sheltered plaza for a brief respite.
Bring: Compact umbrella, Water bottle, Binoculars
Phone tip: Focus on your surroundings; take photos sparingly to truly appreciate the moment.
Phone-down: 42 min
Field challenge:
  [ ] Spot 3 different bird species
  [ ] Identify 2 types of trees
  [ ] Sit quietly for 5 minutes without using your phone
